verdict.rationale: Groq is a pure API/inference service accessed via OpenAI-compatible REST endpoints and SDKs (API key + base_url swap), with batch processing for large-scale asynchronous automation and confirmed live, key-gated JSON endpoints — all of which are inherently scriptable/headless with no GUI dependency, ideal for CI pipelines.
